title: A2Se2C2 (A = Na–Cs): crystalline compounds featuring −Se–CC–Se− dianions with short-range structural disorder
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23037-23043
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01467D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tim Mattick, Marc Hetzert, Uwe Ruschewitz
The crystal structures of A2Se2C2 (A = Na–Cs) with an unusual local disorder of −Se–CC–Se− anions were solved by a combination of conventional IR/Raman and Rietveld analyses, DFT calculations, and total scattering data (pair distribution function).
